HatchPattern__Earth__Meta.Meta__Description: Earth in section - clusters of three short diagonal strokes, each cluster turned the other way from its neighbours. The long-standing drawing-board convention for ground.
HatchPattern__Earth__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__Earth__Meta.Meta__WhyInsideTheTile: Every mark sits wholly inside the tile, so nothing crosses a seam at all: a browser clips a <pattern> at its tile edge and the PDF stamper does not.
HatchPattern__Earth__Meta.Meta__WhyNotScattered: Ground is the one fill drawn as an ORDERED mark: the alternating clusters are the convention, and scattering them would make it read as rubble. The clusters are set on a staggered grid, off the tile's centre lines, so the repeat does not show as a plaid.

HatchPattern__Earth__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__Earth__Identity.Identity__Note: Undisturbed ground below and beside a foundation.

HatchPattern__Earth__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__Earth__Tile.Tile__Note: Four clusters: rising and falling, then falling and rising on the row below.

HatchPattern__Earth__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.35 pt (0.1235 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__Earth__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

Rising.Glyph__Note: A long stroke between two shorter ones, 1.4 mm apart.

HatchPattern__Earth__Placements.Place__Note: Upper right, lifted 0.8 mm so the row is not a ruled line
Lower left, turned the other way from the one above it

HatchPattern__Earth__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a use may scale and turn this pattern before it stops reading as the material.
